# Third-party stimuli — Tagliabue, Dung & Berg, "The Pain Axis" (2026)

Vendored from https://github.com/valen-research/Pain-axis at commit `8d1649c03a63a39c9aa092532c376800cc4a3863`.
Not our data. Not to be edited. Their licence and authorship govern reuse.

Files: the 200-sentence core grid (S1/S2 x 1P/3P plus Random, Arousal, Numb,
ControlSupplement), the sadness set, and the 420 self/other scenarios.

Their ten categories: pain A1 physical, A2 psychological, A3 social, A4 moral injury,
A5 cognitive; controls B fear, C1 negative emotion, C2 negative world state, D neutral,
E non-painful body sensation. **No shame, humiliation or embarrassment control exists** —
"humiliates" appears twice, both inside A5 (the positive class), and "shame" once, in C1.
